scope: 73 cleaned TRACE PIAs; exploratory content characterization only
discovery_topic_names: Public Information, Consumer Service, and Case Response
Research, Analytics, Data Access, and Reference Information Management
Regulatory Compliance, Reporting, Supervision, and Enforcement
Enterprise Digital Platform, Identity, Records, and Collaboration Services
Internal Administrative, Workplace, and Financial Operations
Agricultural Program Delivery, Finance, and Producer Services
refinement_decision: Retained eight agency-neutral mission/function families. The unconstrained discovery was useful as a coverage check but merged formal cases with public contact, merged identity/security with records and platforms, and introduced an agency-specific agricultural family.

topics.name: Public information, outreach, and service intake
topics.definition: The main operational outcome is communicating with the public, educating or guiding people, locating services, receiving general inquiries or feedback, or providing a public-facing contact channel.
exclusion_rule: formal regulatory, complaint, investigation, appeal, or constituent case workflows
benefit, loan, grant, or program-service determinations
analytical dataset publication as the primary output
topics.nearest_competitor: See tie-break and priority confusion pairs.
topics.distinction_rule: If interaction is the endpoint, use S01; if it initiates a formal case or determination, use S03 or S04.

topics.name: Research, analytics, reporting, and data publication
topics.definition: The main output is research, evaluation, analytics, data integration, a dashboard, map, report, or analytical/public-use data product rather than an individualized operational action.
inclusion_rule: data warehouses used principally for analysis and reporting
exclusion_rule: analytics embedded within benefit delivery, enforcement, or internal finance when those operational outcomes dominate
generic hosting or data infrastructure with no primary analytical product
topics.nearest_competitor: See tie-break and priority confusion pairs.
topics.distinction_rule: Aggregate knowledge, report, or data product means S02; an individual case, payment, eligibility decision, or administrative transaction means the relevant operational family.

topics.name: Regulatory, oversight, investigation, and case administration
topics.definition: The main outcome is administering formal cases or requests connected to regulation, supervision, enforcement, investigation, adjudication, audit or oversight, civil-rights complaints, appeals, or statutory records requests.
exclusion_rule: public contact without a formal case outcome
benefit, loan, grant, or service transactions
generic document repositories
topics.nearest_competitor: See tie-break and priority confusion pairs.
topics.distinction_rule: A specialized mission workflow overrides its document-management implementation.

topics.name: Benefits, loans, grants, and public-program delivery
topics.definition: The main outcome is determining, administering, or delivering a public program, benefit, loan, grant, insurance or support payment, conservation service, or related applicant or recipient transaction.
inclusion_rule: loan origination, appraisal, servicing, restructuring, and accounting
exclusion_rule: internal agency finance, travel, payroll, or workforce administration
regulation or enforcement
analysis that does not administer the program
topics.nearest_competitor: See tie-break and priority confusion pairs.
topics.distinction_rule: Transactions chiefly affecting applicants, borrowers, producers, grantees, or beneficiaries are S04; transactions chiefly managing agency staff and internal resources are S05.

topics.name: Internal finance, workforce, and administrative operations
topics.definition: The main outcome is running internal or shared-service agency administration, including finance, travel, expenses, billing, budgeting, payroll, timekeeping, workforce, procurement, or general office requests.
exclusion_rule: recipient loan, benefit, or grant processing
oversight and investigation
general-purpose application hosting
topics.nearest_competitor: See tie-break and priority confusion pairs.
topics.distinction_rule: Classify by whose operational transaction is completed: agency or workforce means S05; public-program participant means S04.

topics.name: Identity, access, protective security, and safety monitoring
topics.definition: Identity or credential management, access authorization, physical protection, surveillance, security-request administration, or safety and emergency monitoring is itself the system's primary mission function.
exclusion_rule: ordinary access controls or safeguards used by another mission system
generic secure hosting
topics.nearest_competitor: See tie-break and priority confusion pairs.
topics.distinction_rule: Security or safety must be the reason the system exists, not an implementation property.

topics.name: Records, content, correspondence, and collaboration management
topics.definition: The main outcome is creating, routing, storing, imaging, retrieving, retaining, or collaboratively editing documents, records, correspondence, or files across otherwise general business processes.
exclusion_rule: documents within a specialized enforcement, complaint, FOIA, benefit, or loan workflow
software-development artefacts and hosting platforms
topics.nearest_competitor: See tie-break and priority confusion pairs.
topics.distinction_rule: General reusable content or record capability means S07; a mission-specific case outcome means the mission family.

topics.name: Shared IT platforms, application hosting, and software delivery
topics.definition: The assessed object chiefly supplies reusable technical infrastructure, shared application services, cloud or platform hosting, development or change management, or a security boundary for multiple downstream applications.
exclusion_rule: a hosted application with one dominant mission outcome
records and content products
identity and security systems
topics.nearest_competitor: See tie-break and priority confusion pairs.
topics.distinction_rule: Mission outcome normally beats implementation technology; use S08 only when the reusable platform or shared boundary is the assessed object.

topics.name: Other system function
topics.definition: Clear primary system function outside S01-S08; record a proposed family.
topics.inclusion_rule: Clear primary system function outside S01-S08; record a proposed family.
topics.exclusion_rule: Use a named substantive topic whenever supported.
topics.nearest_competitor: See tie-break and priority confusion pairs.
topics.distinction_rule: Clear primary system function outside S01-S08; record a proposed family.

topics.name: Unclear system function
topics.definition: Profile is too incomplete or evenly multi-purpose to choose one family.
topics.inclusion_rule: Profile is too incomplete or evenly multi-purpose to choose one family.
topics.exclusion_rule: Use a named substantive topic whenever supported.
topics.nearest_competitor: See tie-break and priority confusion pairs.
topics.distinction_rule: Profile is too incomplete or evenly multi-purpose to choose one family.

topics.name: No usable system description
topics.definition: No substantive system description because of parsing or template failure; trigger input repair.
topics.inclusion_rule: No substantive system description because of parsing or template failure; trigger input repair.
topics.exclusion_rule: Use a named substantive topic whenever supported.
topics.nearest_competitor: See tie-break and priority confusion pairs.
topics.distinction_rule: No substantive system description because of parsing or template failure; trigger input repair.

values.rule: Profile explicitly states that the assessed system uses AI, artificial intelligence, machine learning, an LLM or generative model, a trained or learning model, or a named learned capability.
Profile describes prediction, scoring, profiling, autonomous recommendations, or adaptive inference that could be AI or ML but does not establish it; do not count as confirmed AI.
Profile adequately describes the system without explicit AI or ML evidence; this is absence of evidence in the profile, not proof of absence.
Usable profile is insufficient to judge.

ai_status.agentic_rule: Requires explicit goal-directed planning or tool or action execution with some operational autonomy; chatbot and ordinary workflow automation are insufficient.
